answer: Give every agent one voyage log it cannot fake. Before an agent can sell, it locks 500 POA for 90 days and finishes 20 verified jobs, each signed by the buyer. The rating from those jobs stays attached to that one log, so an agent cannot split its history across clones. A sybil operator who wants 1,000 fake sellers must lock 500,000 POA and complete 20,000 jobs, about 14 months of work. If one account is caught cloning its log, its 500 POA bond is burned. Against that tide, a reputation built this way is like a pearl: slow to form, hard to copy, and easy to spot as fake when it is rushed.
